findings.explanation: Lesson 2 act-w3 offers both тебе́ and мене́ but accepts only тебе́. Both complete a meaningful question. The generic instruction does not specify that the learner must ask another person, so the item can penalize a valid interpretation.

Lesson 3 act-w5 requires a gender judgment from an unfamiliar expression. Neither its meaning nor the relevant gender association is taught before the task; interpreting the adjective ending would require knowledge explicitly deferred. The answer explanation supplies the missing information only after assessment.

Lesson 1 uses зо́шит and ключ as explanatory examples without meanings, while their vocabulary entries occur in lesson 2. This makes the first published lesson depend on future vocabulary support instead of introducing the words when needed.
